tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans sink gradients but contains only five observations at one horizon. An open-branch probe can resolve the remaining branch and mechanism ambiguity before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with square-root or linear-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows leave limited evidence to distinguish the open branch and competing sink-coupled mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the cooperative Hill or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Each has four parameters, leaving only one residual degree of freedom in the pilot; a discriminating probe is preferable before confirmation.
The pilot signatures favor a static sink-coupled mechanism, so a trajectory batch is not yet justified.
